## Context / Problem
The six `infra/compose` files below contain repeated, obvious, or historical prose identified by the comment audit and revalidated on `origin/main` at `9800670821a3e25f3301026c0fb1271b1176e20a`. The remediation must shorten comments without weakening operational or security contracts.

## Approach
Edit only standalone comments and blank lines in the declared files. Preserve executable/configuration text byte-for-byte. Replace incident history and narration with the minimum current rationale needed by each consumer. Before the first Gerrit push, a reviewer who did not author the remediation must inspect the exact candidate commit and persist the complete semantic-preservation and bloat-removal matrix in a leaf-linked per-block receipt. The shared MCP bot posts it; `reviewer_session` identifies the distinct agent who reviewed the prose.

## Scope
- `docker-compose.yml` — Preserve the four-service topology and host-side nginx boundary; Gerrit external bind-volume persistence, `down -v` safety, loopback HTTP/public SSH, and journald consumption; review-bot bounded shutdown/store lock, proxy trust boundary, persistent ticket/signing mounts, UID-mismatch `safe.directory`, paired regions, three model slots/no legacy model variable, usage logs, scratch watermark/admission-marker ordering, and reporting-only healthcheck; opcert authoritative/no-push/external-key/loopback posture; MCP fail-closed non-loopback auth/Host/Origin, stop grace, persistent read-write tickets and blobless code clones, paired regions, soft-degrade PAT/Jira inputs versus fail-closed auth/key files, healthcheck, and parity with `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:mcp_run_new`. Consumers: Compose, deploy/observability scripts, security and operators.
- `Dockerfile.gerrit` — Preserve in-image Python/g2p for Gerrit hooks, Python >=3.11 assertion, exact g2p commit because PyPI lacks compact-ID support, all three hook symlinks, secret exclusion, and final UID 1000. Consumers: image build, hook materialization, Gerrit operators.
- `Dockerfile.mcp` — Preserve OpenSSH >=8.9 for SSHSIG; architecture/version/checksum-pinned ACLI; locked `agents,mcp,bedrock` install with uv-pin parity; unauthenticated loopback health endpoint; and the real entrypoint for persistent tickets/blobless code stores with soft clone failure. The image intentionally has no `USER` directive and runs as root. Consumers: image build, MCP startup and Jira mutation paths.
- `Dockerfile.opcert` — Preserve OpenSSH >=8.9, locked `agents,reviewbot,bedrock` install with uv-pin parity, externally mounted signing key, no application-managed AWS secret fetch, and fixed uvicorn entrypoint. The image intentionally has no `USER` directive and runs as root. Consumers: trusted op-cert image and operators.
- `Dockerfile.reviewbot` — Preserve root-context `.dockerignore` secret/debris exclusion, OpenSSH authorship signing, architecture-aware gitleaks, isolated/offline semgrep, locked explicit `agents,reviewbot,bedrock` install with uv-pin parity, writable-store helper, soft-failure persistent-ticket entrypoint, and root-mounted uvicorn endpoint. The image runs as root, matching Compose. Consumers: image build, scanners, review-bot startup and operators.
- `gerrit.config` — Preserve canonical URL/basePath/serverId; proxy/listener/request logging; SSH/thread bounds; heap/JDK-21/off-heap limits; fail-closed OAuth prerequisites with secret separation; Lucene/NoteDb and signed-push posture; whole-topic collision warning; explicit mail disablement and restart requirement. Consumers: Gerrit, `compose-up.sh`, autodeploy signaling and operators.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The Bitumen-owned six files in the grouped commit change only standalone comments or blank lines.
- [x] Before the first Gerrit push, every Scope constraint and consumer contract has a PASS row with concrete before/after citations against the exact candidate commit in a leaf-linked per-block review receipt authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.
- [x] Every edited comment block has an independent `bloat-removal` PASS row confirming that redundant, obvious, duplicated, or historical prose was removed while current non-obvious rationale remained.
- [x] Focused infra/config tests, `git diff --check`, repository lint, repository type checking, and untimed local `make verify` pass on the grouped signed commit before Gerrit push.
- [x] No missing or FAIL semantic-preservation row remains at closure.

## Verification
Run the persisted comment-only diff guard, focused infra/config checks, path-scoped `git diff --check`, worktree-venv `make lint`, worktree-venv `make typecheck`, and untimed local `make verify` with the arm64 Pandoc override before Gerrit push. Semantic preservation is judged by the independent exact-candidate matrix. This leaf shares one signed change with the two Group19 test-prose leaves.
